item.title: [BARC.L] Barclays CEO Plays Down Private-Credit Risks
item.description: Barclays should record a materially lower impairment than the £500 million—roughly $665 million—it is owed by collapsed U.K. mortgage lender Market Financial Solutions, Chief Executive C.S. Venkatakrishnan said Wednesday, and downplayed the risks to banks from any private-credit meltdown. Venkatakrishnan said MFS, where Barclays lent to MFS investment vehicles that then made loans to mortgage borrowers, wouldn't even count in that definition, but was instead a form of securitized lending. Risks from private-credit funds running into trouble shouldn't hit banks in any systemic way, Venkatakrishnan said, adding that they were still a relatively small part of the overall credit market.
